cases.title: Murders in Moscow: The Plea
cases.summary: DO NOT RETELL THE MURDERS. This is a follow-up for listeners who already heard the 2025 episode. Chapter 1 and ONLY chapter 1 recaps November 13 2022 in a few sentences: the King Road house, Ethan Chapin, Madison Mogen, Xana Kernodle, Kaylee Goncalves, the two surviving roommates, the knife-sheath DNA, the arrest. Chapters 2 through 12 cover ONLY what happened after the arrest and must not revisit the night of the murders: the capital case and the death-penalty filing, the defence motions and the DNA and cell-site fights, the June 30 2025 plea agreement, the July 2 2025 guilty plea to all five counts with appeals waived, the victim impact statements, the July 23 2025 sentencing to four consecutive life terms plus ten years, the gag order and released case files, and the July 2026 motion to withdraw the plea claiming ineffective counsel and coercion. He pleaded guilty and is serving life; he has moved to withdraw that plea and the court has not ruled.

cases.title: JonBenet Ramsey: Thirty Years
cases.summary: A follow-up to the 2022 episodes, timed to the thirtieth anniversary in December 2026. ONE short chapter recapping December 26 1996, the ransom note, the 5:52 a.m. call and the discovery in the basement. The rest is the thirty years since and what has moved recently: the 2008 touch-DNA testing and the exoneration letter, the grand jury documents, Boulder Police's annual updates, and the department's December 2025 statement that it had conducted new interviews and re-tested evidence with current DNA technology. Nobody has ever been charged; name no suspects.

cases.title: The Murdaugh Family Murders
cases.summary:
Hey everyone, Cory here. Today we are looking at a case that completely consumed the South Carolina Lowcountry. The Murdaugh family was a legal dynasty, but everything started to unravel on a June night in 2021 when Maggie and Paul Murdaugh were found dead near the dog kennels of their hunting lodge.

Alex Murdaugh claimed he was visiting his mother who had dementia when the murders happened. But as investigators dug deeper, cellphone data and a crucial video started telling a very different story. We are diving into the timeline, the botched crime scene, and the massive trial that followed.

cases.summary: In this gripping episode of Crime Time Snacks , we delve into the harrowing case of the Idaho student murders that rocked the nation. This episode unpacks the chilling events, the ongoing investigation, and the complexities surrounding the case.

cases.title: The Menendez Brothers: The Parole Years
cases.summary:
Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: what happened to Lyle and Erik Menendez after the verdict. Thirty years of appeals that went nowhere, the marriages inside prison walls, the TikTok generation that heard the abuse testimony differently, a letter found in a dresser, and a former Menudo member who came forward in 2023.

Then the part that is still moving: one district attorney who asked for resentencing and another who called their defense self-serving lies, the May 2025 ruling that cut their sentences to fifty years to life, the parole board that said no three months later, the judge who refused a new trial, and the early parole hearing now set for March 2027.

I covered the murders and the trials in an earlier episode, so this one tells 1989 once and spends its time on everything since.

cases.title: The Delphi Murder Case 2017
cases.summary: On February 14, 2017, the bodies of Abigail Williams (June 23, 2003 – February 13, 2017) and Liberty German (December 27, 2002 – February 13, 2017) were discovered near the Monon High Bridge Trail. The case has had no prominent suspects until recently. On October 28th police announced they had made an arrest in the case. A 50 year old Delphi Resident was arrested and charged with two felony counts of murder. Listen while we dive into the case starting over 5 years ago in on a beautiful hiking trail.

cases.title: The Miami Apartment Stabbing
cases.summary: Courtney Clenney was arrested on August 10, 2022. She pleaded guilty on August 10, 2026. Four years, to the day, and the case still did not answer its own question. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the killing of Christian Obumseli in a Miami high-rise. The fourteen minutes on April 3, 2022, the elevator video, the medical examiner's finding that broke the self-defense account, the four months before an arrest, the battered spouse defense that never reached a jury, and what a plea leaves unsettled. If any of this sounds like your life, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 800-799-7233.

cases.title: The Interrogation of Chris Watts
cases.summary: Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the forty-eight hours in which Chris Watts's story came apart on camera. A friend who would not leave a doorstep, a patrol officer who noticed a husband was too calm, a neighbor's security camera, an FBI agent who held back his best evidence, a polygraph score of negative 18, and the way out that investigators offered him. Where the published accounts disagree, I say so. From the welfare check on August 13, 2018 to the oil site at 11 that night two days later, then the plea, the sentence, and the versions of the story he has told since.

cases.title: Watts Family Murders
cases.summary: The Watts family murders occurred in August 2018 in Frederick, Colorado. Chris Watts, the father, killed his pregnant wife, Shanann, and their two young daughters, Bella and Celeste. The crime gained significant media attention due to its horrific nature and the subsequent investigation. Watts initially denied involvement but later confessed to the murders. He was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. The case continues to be a source of fascination and discussion for true crime enthusiasts.

cases.title: JonBenét Ramsey
cases.summary: JonBenét Patricia Ramsey was murdered. That is the only certain thing about this case after 26 years. There is key evidence in this case, as well as more theories than there are people involved. I took weeks of research and broke it down into a two-part segment where I go over all the facts known in the case today, as well as some key suspects. I try to stay away from the theories that have little to no factual basis. Listen to the facts of the case and form your own opinion. Visit CrimeTimeSnacks.com to stay even more involved and join an ever-growing true crime community. -@CrimeTimeSnacks

cases.title: JonBenét Ramsey Americas Child Beauty Queen
cases.summary: In Boulder, Colorado, just a day after Christmas in 1996, JonBenét Ramsey, a six-year-old child pageant star, was found dead in her basement. She had been beaten and strangled. That was hours after her parents, John and Patsy, reported her missing, and hours after her mom found a ransom note on a staircase in the house. Nobody has ever been convicted in this case, even 26 years later. This is the lead-in to a two-part special where we go back to Christmas 1996 and look again at all the facts in this case.

updates.title: Rex Heuermann disciplined in prison after synthetic marijuana paper found in cell
updates.summary: Convicted Gilgo Beach serial killer Rex Heuermann was disciplined at Clinton Correctional Facility after guards discovered paper soaked in synthetic marijuana in his cell. Heuermann was moved to an isolated cellblock and temporarily had his mail privileges suspended.

updates.title: Judge Dismisses $50M Wrongful Death Lawsuit Against Moab Police
